patch_description: Builds on the best-performing mixed CRZ/CRY pairwise-entangling ansatz (score 0.60) by adding: (1) a single shared RX "mixing" rotation across all 9 qubits (only 1 extra unique parameter) to introduce X-axis diversity absent from the previous RY/RZ-only design, and (2) three CCRZ three-qubit interaction gates on triples that partition all 9 qubits exactly once ([0,5,6], [1,4,7], [2,3,8]), giving the circuit access to higher-order correlations that the restricted 2-qubit connectivity graph cannot express directly. The pairwise CRZ/CRY entangling layer and the RY encoding / RZ output layers are kept identical to the best prior design so as not to lose established gains. Total unique parameters increase modestly from 30 to 34 (204 trainable with the fixed x6 repetition factor), aiming to reduce the generalization gap and boost validation/test accuracy through richer, more global correlations rather than simply adding more pairwise capacity.
